runbook: R-18 / R-19 (fresh independent oracle; evidence tree = git archive HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md, nothing else read)
what_the_leaf_asserts: The scenario's rotation receipt carries a `consume` list — the ability slots the derived-order layer classifies as consumers of a setup resource. The change appends a 4th entry, W, to a previously 3-entry list (only index 3 moved, so the list is append/derivation-ordered, not slot-ordered: a slot-ordered rebuild inserting W would have shifted indices 1 and 2 as well).

step_1_is_W_a_consumer_at_all.claim: Force of Will (W) is Syndra's canonical Dark-Sphere consumer; Dark Sphere (Q) is the producer. The setup->consume edge Q -> W is stated verbatim in the cached wiki text.
evidence: Q active (data/champions.json Syndra.abilities.Q effects[0]): 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.' -> Q PRODUCES the resource.

W active (Syndra.abilities.W effects[0]): 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds.'
W recast (effects[2]): 'Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land.' -> the sphere is expended as the projectile.
W notes: 'Grabbing prioritizes Dark Spheres.' -> with any sphere on the field, W always takes the sphere, i.e. the consume edge is unconditional in a rotation that opened with Q.

W notes: 'Grabbing a Dark Sphere will cause the duration on it to refresh, but only on the first cast, not when it is thrown.' -> the thrown sphere is not returned to the live pool; the resource is spent.
Q notes: 'Dark Sphere can be conjured inside terrain, but cannot be thrown there with Force of Will.' -> the wiki itself names Q's sphere as W's ammunition.
step_1_is_W_a_consumer_at_all.conclusion: W must appear in the consume list. Its absence was the defect.

step_2_is_W_a_consumer_at_120_splinters_.claim: At the scenario's 120 Splinters of Wrath, W additionally carries its Transcendent enhanced branch, so W is consume-tagged on the stack-threshold signal too. The cached leveling rows for that branch reproduce exactly from the prose, so the branch is real and not a parser artifact.
step_2_is_W_a_consumer_at_120_splinters_.wiki_prose: W effects[3]: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.' P effects[0]: splinters stack 'up to 120 times'; P effects[2]: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' 120 >= 60, so the W branch is live in this scenario.
arithmetic: Base W magic damage rank 5 = 190 (+65% AP) [cached 'Magic Damage' row].
Flat term: 0.12 * 190 = 22.8  == cached 'Bonus True Damage' rank-5 flat 22.8. MATCH
Total mixed rank 5: 190*1.12 = 212.8 == cached 'Total Mixed Damage' 212.8; AP 0.65 + 0.116 = 0.766 = 76.6% AP == cached 76.6% AP. MATCH
step_2_is_W_a_consumer_at_120_splinters_.conclusion: The enhanced (consume-signal) branch of W is present, cached and internally consistent at 120 splinters.

step_3_why_index_3_last.claim: If the consume list is ordered by position in the derived cast order, W belongs LAST among Syndra's sphere consumers — index 3 of a 4-entry list — because casting W earlier strictly removes a sphere from Unleashed Power's grab pool, while E does not.
evidence: R active: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target ... each dealing magic damage upon hit.' (rank-3 rows: 160 (+20% AP) Magic Damage per Sphere, Minimum 480 (+60% AP), Maximum 1120 (+140% AP)) -> extra live spheres are worth 160 (+20% AP) each.
R notes: 'Unleashed Power will not add a Sphere that Syndra is holding with Force of Will.' -> a W cast held/thrown before R denies R one sphere, i.e. 160 (+20% AP) at rank 3.

E notes: 'Scatter the Weak will delay the expiration of a Sphere until after it finishes being knocked back.' and E active only knocks spheres back; the sphere stays live -> E before R costs nothing (R note only excludes spheres 'being pushed by Scatter the Weak' that were made late during the push).

R active tail: 'The Dark Spheres will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.' -> R leaves spheres behind, so a post-R W still finds a sphere to throw; the reverse order does not restore R's lost sphere.
step_3_why_index_3_last.conclusion: W-after-R is the damage-maximizing placement and the only ordering consistent with the two cited notes; W as the final consume entry is right.

step_4_list_length.claim: A 4-entry consume list for Syndra at 120 splinters is the expected cardinality.
step_4_list_length.reasoning: Every one of Q/W/E/R carries a Transcendent threshold branch that is live at 120 splinters (Q at 40: stocked charge, an ammo resource that is spent per cast; W at 60; E at 80; R at 100), and W/E/R all act on the Q-produced Dark Sphere pool. Four consume-classified slots, W appended last, matches the observed single-leaf append at index 3.

residual_uncertainty: The evidence tree contains no schema for the rotation receipt (no scenario definition under data/), so the list's ordering convention is inferred from the diff shape (single append at index 3) rather than read. That inference does not affect membership: on every reading of the cached wiki text, W is a Dark-Sphere consumer and belongs in the list, and the last position is the one the R-note ('will not add a Sphere that Syndra is holding with Force of Will') requires. Both the membership claim and the position claim favour the new value.
aside_not_part_of_verdict: The cached W 'Bonus True Damage' / 'Total Mixed Damage' rows carry a third modifier of 1.14% AP with a rank-invariant value, which the prose implies should be the quadratic cross-term 0.02 x 0.65 = 1.3% AP per 100 AP. The flat and linear terms reproduce exactly (checked above); only this second-order term is off by 0.16 pp per 100 AP. Wiki-side rounding artifact, immaterial to this leaf, but worth a look if anything ever prices W's true damage off the third modifier.
